name: MOF-808-Lys, 2024 25 C dry conditional

evidence.basis: A digitized 25 C dry CO2 adsorption curve is used as the measured reference shape. Reversible hot behavior, isosteric heat, intrinsic rates and the shared shaped basis are explicit screening assumptions because complete source evidence is absent.
evidence.not_for: humid coadsorption or hydration-history prediction, equilibrium-complete hot vacuum prediction, intrinsic kinetics, shaped-device prediction, lifetime, CSS, annual production, hardware qualification or a measured winner.

shaped_material.basis: The source sample is a functionalized MOF powder. Its mol/kg loadings are mapped to the shared 10 kg complete dry shaped inventory under an explicit unity loading-retention and mass-transfer assumption; this is not evidence of a binder-free shaped body.
shaped_material.binder_support: No candidate-specific binder, support or final shaped mass fraction is supplied; none is inferred.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: No candidate-specific shaped particle geometry is supplied; the shared case geometry and transport values are named transfers.

co2.basis: Measured dry 25 C filled-marker CO2 adsorption curve digitized from SI Figure S65. No temperature-dependent source curve, fit or measured isosteric heat is available for the reversible hot scenario.

reference_curve.class: measured, digitized from publisher figure; nonnegative monotone adsorption branch
reference_curve.source_locator: JACS 2024 supporting information Figure S65, printed page 52, linear/log views of the same 25 C curve
reference_curve.source_completeness: Filled adsorption symbols detected; highest-pressure symbols obscured by open desorption markers were not recovered. This is not a complete numeric extraction.

support.note: The source methods mention 288, 298 and 308 K, but the supplied Figures S65/S70 expose a 25 C curve only. No multi-temperature array is claimed.

water.basis: No defensible coupled humid chemistry or hydration-history law is represented. Water storage, rates, heat and adsorbed Cp are exactly zero; the positive normalizer is a numerical state-layout scale only. Every selected weather interval must have RH exactly zero.

kinetics.evidence_status: ASSUMED_LDF_SCREENING_SCALE: no intrinsic adsorption or desorption kinetics were extracted; both directions use a named 1e-4 s^-1 scenario assumption.

sample_identity.description: MOF-808 functionalized with L-lysine; distinct from MOF-808-TAPA and from the historical mmen materials.

co2.statement: Measured and digitized 25 C dry adsorption shape from SI Figure S65; the reversible hot heat shift is an explicit assumption, not a fitted or measured result.

co2_reference_curve.decision: Retain the SI table value and digitized interpolation separately. They agree within the stated digitization uncertainty; no rescaling is applied.

co2_temperature_shift.basis: Named amine-material screening assumption used with the existing constant activity-shift law. It is not fitted to data and is not a measured or published MOF-808-Lys heat.

kinetics.basis: Named LDF scenario scale; finite-time breakthrough or cycling data are not converted into intrinsic kinetics.

solid_cp.basis: Neutral screening value; no MOF-808-Lys-specific heat capacity is claimed.

thermal.statement: Assumed 1000 J/kg/K dry solid Cp and transferred shared shaped thermal basis; no candidate-specific measurement is claimed.

shaped_transport.basis: The shared app geometry and transport inputs are used for a complete dry shaped basis. No candidate-specific pellet, binder, density or effective diffusivity is claimed.

mass_mapping.executable_inventory_basis: per kg complete dry shaped inventory in the shared app case
mass_mapping.basis: Source powder mol/kg loadings are applied directly to the shared 10 kg complete dry shaped inventory under a named unity loading-retention and mass-transfer assumption. No binder-free shaped-body claim follows.

water.class: numerical structural mode; no physical coefficients

source_table_context.source_locator: Supporting Information Table S4, printed page 57

reported_cycling_context.class: measured protocol, not a kinetic or equilibrium law
reported_cycling_context.description: The source reports temperature-swing cycling with 140 C Ar purge until outlet CO2 reaches 20 ppm. The 120 C TPD peak is not a cycling setpoint.

assumptions: A constant 70 kJ/mol isosteric heat is a named screening assumption for a possible reversible hot scenario; its broad 40-100 kJ/mol range is not experimental uncertainty.
A 1e-4 s^-1 LDF rate in both directions is a named scenario assumption with a broad 1e-5 to 1e-3 s^-1 range; no intrinsic kinetics are claimed.
A 1000 J/kg/K dry solid Cp is a named scenario assumption with a broad 700-1500 J/kg/K range.
The shared 10 kg dry shaped basis, geometry and transport are transferred assumptions because no candidate-specific pellet, binder, density or transport measurements are supplied.

Source powder mol/kg loadings map to the complete dry shaped inventory with an explicit unity loading-retention and mass-transfer assumption; binder fraction, shaped density and effective transport remain unknown and no binder-free shaped body is claimed.
The measured 25 C dry curve is not extrapolated as a demonstrated hot equilibrium law; the existing constant-heat activity transfer is conditional and not validated against withheld temperatures.
Dry-only water handling has zero physical water storage, rates, heat and adsorbed Cp; any nonzero relative humidity is rejected.
The two SI views are the same 25 C curve and provide no independent multi-temperature validation.

uncertainty.statement: Digitization uncertainty is retained. Hot heat, dry solid Cp, LDF and shaped transport are broad named scenario assumptions, not measurements, fits or repairable validation failures.
uncertainty.digitization: Per-point center uncertainty and 40 Pa interpolation uncertainty are retained in the digitization audit. Experimental uncertainty was not supplied.
uncertainty.thermal_and_kinetic: Heat, dry solid Cp and LDF values are named scenario assumptions with broad ranges, not fitted coefficients or experimental uncertainty.
uncertainty.representation: No hot or humid representation gate was passed. The package remains a conditional dry screening scenario.

validity.co2: Conditional 25 C measured dry reference shape. The reversible hot activity shift is an explicitly assumed scenario and is not validated equilibrium data.
validity.co2_dry_equilibrium: Valid as a conditional 25 C measured reference-shape scenario. Hot behavior is a named constant-heat extrapolation, not validated equilibrium data.
validity.initial_state_interpretation: The app's declared initial state is a scenario, not cyclic steady state.
validity.kinetics: Both-direction LDF rates are scenario assumptions; no intrinsic material kinetics are claimed.
validity.thermal: Solid Cp and shaped transport are assumptions.
validity.water: Dry-only. Any nonzero relative humidity at the case or weather forcing boundary is rejected; direct humidity and hydration-history physics are unrepresented.
